crossRefs.note: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity, and sow trouble, reap the same.
Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.

Hear, earth! Behold, I will bring evil on this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened…
Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
